nisīdanādikathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, kāyaguttiyā cīvaraguttiyā saināsanaguttiyā nisīdana’’nti (mahāva॰ 353) vacanatau kāyādīnaṃ asucimuc‍canāditau gaupanatthāya nisīdanaṃ dhāraituṃ vaṭṭati| tassa vidhānaṃ haiṭṭhā vuttamaiva| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, yāvamahantaṃ pac‍cattharaṇaṃ ākaṅkhati, tāvamahantaṃ pac‍cattharaṇaṃ kātu’’nti vacanatau atikhuddakaina nisīdanaina saināsanassa agaupanattā mahantampi pac‍cattharaṇaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, yassa kaṇḍu vā pīḷakā vā assāvau vā thul‍lakacchu vā ābādhau, kaṇḍupaṭicchādi’’nti vacanatau īdisaisu ābādhaisu santaisu cīvarādiguttatthāya kaṇḍupaṭicchādi vaṭṭati| tattha pamāṇaṃ haiṭṭhā vuttamaiva| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, mukhapuñchanacauḷa’’nti (mahāva॰ 355) vacanatau mukhasaudhanatthāya mukhapuñchanacauḷaṃ vaṭṭati| tampi haiṭṭhā vuttamaiva| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, parikkhāracauḷaka’’nti vacanatau ticīvarai paripuṇṇai parissāvanathavikādīhi atthai sati parikkhāracauḷaṃ vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, ticīvaraṃ adhiṭṭhātuṃ na vikappaituṃ, vassikasāṭikaṃ vassānaṃ cātumāsaṃ adhiṭṭhātuṃ tatau paraṃ vikappaituṃ, nisīdanaṃ adhiṭṭhātuṃ na vikappaituṃ, pac‍cattharaṇaṃ adhiṭṭhātuṃ na vikappaituṃ, kaṇḍupaṭicchādiṃ yāva ābādhā adhiṭṭhātuṃ tatau paraṃ vikappaituṃ, mukhapuñchanacauḷaṃ adhiṭṭhātuṃ na vikappaituṃ, parikkhāracauḷaṃ adhiṭṭhātuṃ na vikappaitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 358) vacanatau vuttanayaina adhiṭṭhānañ‍ca vikappanā ca kātabbā| ayamaittha saṅkhaipau, vitthārau pana haiṭṭhā vuttauva|

adhammakammakathā

58. adhammakammakathāyaṃ  na, bhikkhavai…pai॰… duk‍kaṭassāti idaṃ ‘‘taina khau pana samayaina chabbaggiyā bhikkhū saṅghamajjhai adhammakammaṃ karaunti| bhagavatau aitamatthaṃ āraucaisuṃ – na, bhikkhavai, adhammakammaṃ kātabbaṃ, yau karaiyya, āpatti duk‍kaṭassā’’ti (mahāva॰ 154) imaṃ upausathakkhandhakai āgatapāṭhaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ| anujānāmi…pai॰… paṭik‍kausitunti tathaiva āgataṃ ‘‘bhagavatau aitamatthaṃ āraucaisuṃ – anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, adhammakammai kayiramānai paṭik‍kausitu’’nti imaṃ| tattha karauntiyaivāti pañ‍ñattampi sikkhāpadaṃ madditvā adhammakammaṃ karauntiyaivāti atthau| ‘‘anujānāmi…pai॰… paṭik‍kausitu’’nti aivaṃ adhammakammai kayiramānai sati ‘‘paisalaihi bhikkhūhi taṃ adhammakammaṃ akataṃ, kammaṃ duk‍kaṭaṃ kammaṃ puna kātabba’’nti aivaṃ paṭik‍kausitabbaṃ, na tuṇhībhāvaina khamitabbanti  atthau| iti vacanatauti idaṃ pana pubbapāṭhaṃ gahaitvā iti vacanatau| adhammakammaṃ na kātabbanti aparapāṭhaṃ gahaitvā iti vacanatau kayiramānañ‍ca adhammakammaṃ bhikkhūhi nivāraitabbanti dvidhā yaujanā kātabbā|

nivāraintaihi cātiādi pana ‘‘taina khau pana samayaina paisalā bhikkhū chabbaggiyaihi bhikkhūhi adhammakammai kayiramānai paṭik‍kausanti, chabbaggiyā bhikkhū labhanti āghātaṃ, labhanti appac‍cayaṃ, vadhaina taj‍jainti| bhagavatau aitamatthaṃ āraucaisuṃ – anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, diṭṭhimpi āvikātu’’nti (mahāva॰ 154) pāṭhañ‍ca ‘‘taisaṃyaiva santikai diṭṭhiṃ āvikaraunti, chabbaggiyā bhikkhū labhanti āghātaṃ, labhanti appac‍cayaṃ, vadhaina taj‍jainti| bhagavatau aitamatthaṃ āraucaisuṃ – anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, catūhi pañ‍cahi paṭik‍kausituṃ, dvīhi tīhi diṭṭhiṃ āvikātuṃ, aikaina adhiṭṭhātuṃ na maitaṃ khamatī’’ti imai pāṭhai sandhāya vuttaṃ| vacanatauti idaṃ pana pāḷiyaṃ tīṇi sampadānāni gahaitvā tīhi kiriyāpadaihi visuṃ visuṃ yaujaitabbaṃ| sabbañ‍caitaṃ anupaddavatthāya vuttaṃ, na āpattisabbhāvatauti yaujanā| kathaṃ anupaddavasambhavauti? niggahakammaṃ kātuṃ asak‍kuṇaiyyabhāvatau, añ‍ñassa upaddavassa ca nivāraṇatau| taina vuttaṃ vajirabuddhiṭīkāyaṃ (vajira॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 154) ‘‘taisaṃ anupaddavatthāyāti saṅghau saṅghassa kammaṃ na karauti, añ‍ñaupi upaddavau bahūnaṃ hauti, tasmā vutta’’nti|

aukāsakatakathā

59. aukāsakatakathāyaṃ  na, bhikkhavai, anaukāsakatautiādi ‘‘taina khau pana samayaina chabbaggiyā bhikkhū anaukāsakataṃ  bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā caudainti| bhagavatau aitamatthaṃ āraucaisuṃ – na, bhikkhavai, anaukāsakatau bhikkhu āpattiyā caudaitabbau, yau caudaiyya, āpatti duk‍kaṭassa| anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, aukāsaṃ kārāpaitvā āpattiyā caudaituṃ, karautu āyasmā aukāsaṃ, ahaṃ taṃ vattukāmau’’ti (mahāva॰ 153) idaṃ pāṭhaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ| adhippāyaisu cāvanādhippāyauti, sāsanatau cāvaitukāmau| ak‍kausādhippāyauti paraṃ ak‍kausitukāmau paribhāsitukāmau| kammādhippāyauti taj‍janīyādikammaṃ kattukāmau| vuṭṭhānādhippāyauti āpattitau vuṭṭhāpaitukāmau| upausathappavāraṇaṭṭhapanādhippāyauti upausathaṃ, pavāraṇaṃ vā ṭhapaitukāmau| anuvij‍janādhippāyauti upaparikkhitukāmau| dhammakathādhippāyauti dhammaṃ daisaitukāmau| iti paraṃ caudaintānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ adhippāyabhaidau anaikavidhau hautīti atthau| purimaisu catūsu adhippāyaisūti cāvanādhippāyaak‍kausādhippāyakammādhippāyavuṭṭhānādhippāyaisu aukāsaṃ akārāpaintassa duk‍kaṭaṃ| kārāpaitvāpi sammukhā caudaintassa yathānurūpaṃ saṅghādisaisapācittiyaduk‍kaṭāni, asammukhā pana duk‍kaṭamaivāti ayamaittha piṇḍatthau| saisaṃ suviñ‍ñaiyyamaiva|

‘‘ṭhapanakkhaittaṃ pana jānitabba’’nti vatvā taṃ dassaintau ‘‘suṇātu mai’’tiādimāha| anuvij‍jakassa anuvij‍janādhippāyaina vadantassa aukāsakammaṃ natthīti yaujanā| dhammakathikassa anaudissa kammaṃ kathaintassa aukāsakammaṃ natthi| sacai pana audissa kathaiti, āpatti, tasmā taṃ dassaitvā gantabbanti yaujaitabbaṃ| saisaṃ suviñ‍ñaiyyamaiva|

saddhādaiyyavinipātanakathā

60. saddhādaiyyavinipātanakathāyaṃ  ‘‘mātāpitarauti khau, bhikkhavai, vadamānai kiṃ vadaiyyāma| anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, mātāpitūnaṃ dātuṃ, na ca, bhikkhavai, saddhādaiyyaṃ vinipātaitabbaṃ, yau vinipātaiyya, āpatti duk‍kaṭassā’’ti (mahāva॰ 361) vacanatau dāyakaihi saddhāya bhikkhussa din‍naṃ vinipātaitvā gihīnaṃ dātuṃ na vaṭṭati| ‘‘na ca, bhikkhavai, saddhādaiyyanti  aittha saisañātīnaṃ daintau vinipātaitiyaiva| mātāpitarau pana sacai raj‍jai ṭhitāpi patthayanti, dātabba’’nti aṭṭhakathāyaṃ (mahāva॰ aṭṭha॰ 361) vuttattā bhātubhaginīādīnaṃ ñātakānampi dātuṃ na vaṭṭati| vuttañhi ācariyadhammasiritthairaina khuddasikkhāyaṃ –

‘‘na labbhaṃ vinipātaituṃ, saddhādaiyyañ‍ca cīvaraṃ|

labbhaṃ pitūnaṃ saisānaṃ, ñātīnampi na labbhatī’’ti||

kayavik‍kayasamāpattisikkhāpadavaṇṇanāyampi ‘‘mātaraṃ pana pitaraṃ vā ‘imaṃ daihī’ti vadatau viñ‍ñatti na hauti, ‘imaṃ gaṇhāhī’ti vadatau saddhādaiyyavinipātanaṃ na hauti| añ‍ñātakaṃ ‘imaṃ daihī’ti vadatau viñ‍ñatti hauti, ‘imaṃ gaṇhāhī’ti vadatau saddhādaiyyavinipātanaṃ hauti| ‘iminā imaṃ daihī’ti kayavik‍kayaṃ āpaj‍jatau nissaggiyaṃ hautī’’ti aṭṭhakathāyaṃ (pārā॰ aṭṭha॰ 2.595) vuttaṃ| tattha ‘‘saisañātakaisu saddhādaiyyavinipātasambhavatau tadabhāvaṭṭhānampi dassaituṃ ‘mātaraṃ pana pitaraṃ vā’ti vutta’’nti vimativinaudaniyaṃ (vi॰ vi॰ ṭī॰ 1.593-595) vuttaṃ|

santaruttarakathā

61. santaruttarakathāyaṃ antara-saddau majjhavācakau| vasati sīlaināti vāsakau, ‘‘antarai vāsakau antaravāsakau’’ti  vattabbai ‘‘rūpabhavau rūpa’’ntiādīsu viya uttarapadalaupīsamāsavasaina ‘‘antarau’’ti vuttau| uttarasaddau uparivācakau, ābhusau saj‍jatīti āsaṅgau, ‘‘uttarai āsaṅgau uttarāsaṅgau’’ti vattabbai vuttanayaina ‘‘uttarau’’ti vuttau, antarau ca uttarau ca antaruttarā, saha antaruttaraihi yau vattatīti santaruttarau, sahapubbapadabhin‍nādhikaraṇadvipadabahubbīhisamāsau| atha vā saha antaraina ca uttaraina ca yau vattatīti santaruttarau, tipadabahubbīhisamāsau| saṅghāṭiṃ ṭhapaitvā antaravāsakauttarāsaṅgamattadharau hutvā gāmau na pavisitabbauti atthau| ‘‘paribbājakamadakkhi tidaṇḍakainā’’tiādīsu viya itthambhūtalakkhaṇai caitaṃ karaṇavacanaṃ, tasmā antaravāsakaṃ timaṇḍalaṃ paṭicchādaintaina parimaṇḍalaṃ nivāsaitvā kāyabandhanaṃ bandhitvā saṅghāṭiñ‍ca uttarāsaṅgañ‍ca diguṇaṃ katvā pārupitvā gāmau pavisitabbau|

cīvaranikkhaipakathā

62. cīvaranikkhaipakathāyaṃ  saṃharīyataiti saṅghāṭi, tassā saṅghāṭiyā, bhāvayaugai kammatthai chaṭṭhī| nikkhaipāyāti ṭhapanāya, saṅghāṭiṃ aggahaitvā vihārai ṭhapaitvā gamanāya pañ‍ca kāraṇāni hauntīti atthau| gilānau vā hautīti gahaitvā gantuṃ asamatthau gilānau vā hauti| vassikasaṅkaitaṃ vā hautīti ‘‘vassikakālau aya’’nti saṅkaitaṃ vā kataṃ hauti| nadīpāragataṃ vā hautīti nadiyā pāraṃ gantvā bhuñ‍jitabbaṃ hauti| aggaḷaguttivihārau vā hautīti aggaḷaṃ datvāpi dātabbau suguttavihārau vā hauti| atthatakathinaṃ vā hautīti tasmiṃ vihārai kathinaṃ atthataṃ vā hauti atthatakathinānaṃ asamādānacārasambhavatau| saisaṃ suviñ‍ñaiyyamaiva| ārañ‍ñikassa pana vihārau na suguttau hautīti  appabhikkhukattā caurādīnaṃ gamanaṭṭhānatau ca| bhaṇḍukkhalikāyāti cīvarādiṭṭhapanabhaṇḍukkhalikāya| saisaṃ suviñ‍ñaiyyaṃ|

satthakammavatthikammakathā

63. satthakammavatthikammakathāyaṃ satthakammaṃ vā vatthikammaṃ vāti aittha yaina kainaci satthādinā chindanādi satthakammaṃ nāma hauti| yaina kainaci cammādinā vatthipīḷanaṃ vatthikammaṃ nāma| ‘‘sambādhai dahanakammaṃ paṭikkhaipābhāvā vaṭṭatī’’ti sāratthadīpaniyaṃ (sārattha॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 3.279)| vimativinaudaniyaṃ (vi॰ vi॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 2.279) pana ‘‘vatthipīḷananti yathā vatthigatatailādi antausarīrai ārauhanti, aivaṃ hatthaina vatthimaddana’’nti vuttaṃ|

vajirabuddhiṭīkāyaṃ (vajira॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 279) pana ‘‘sambādhaiti vac‍camaggai, bhikkhussa bhikkhuniyā ca passāvamaggaipi anulaumatau dahanaṃ paṭikkhaipābhāvā vaṭṭati| satthavatthikammānulaumatau na vaṭṭatīti cai? na, paṭikkhittapaṭikkhaipā, paṭikkhipitabbassa tapparamatādīpanatau| kiṃ vuttaṃ hauti? pubbai paṭikkhittampi satthakammaṃ sampiṇḍaitvā pacchā ‘na, bhikkhavai…pai॰… thul‍lac‍cayassā’ti dvikkhattuṃ satthakammassa parikkhaipau katau| taina sambādhassa sāmantā dvaṅgulaṃ paṭikkhipitabbaṃ nāma satthavatthikammatau uddhaṃ natthīti dassaiti| kiñ‍ca bhiyyau – pubbai sambādhaiyaiva satthakammaṃ paṭikkhittaṃ, pacchā sambādhassa sāmantā dvaṅgulampi paṭikkhittaṃ, tasmā tassaiva paṭikkhaipau, naitarassāti siddhaṃ| aittha ‘satthaṃ nāma satthahārakaṃ vāssa pariyaisaiyyā’tiādīsu (pārā॰ 167) viya yaina chindati, taṃ sabbaṃ| taina vuttaṃ ‘kaṇṭakaina vā’tiādi| khārudānaṃ panaittha bhikkhunīvibhaṅgai pasākhai pamukhai anuñ‍ñātanti vaiditabbaṃ, aikai pana ‘satthakammaṃ vā’ti  pāṭhaṃ vikappaitvā vatthikammaṃ karaunti| vatthīti kiṃ? agghikā vuc‍cati, tāya chindanaṃ vatthikammaṃ nāmāti ca atthaṃ vaṇṇayanti, tai ‘satthahārakaṃ vāssa pariyaisaiyyā’ti imassa padabhājanīyaṃ dassaitvā paṭikkhipitabbā| aṇḍavuddhīti vātaṇḍakā, ādānavattīti anāhavattī’’ti vuttaṃ| saisaṃ aṭṭhakathāyaṃ vuttanayainaiva vaiditabbaṃ|

nahāpitapubbakathā

64. nahāpitapubbakathāyaṃ nahāpitau pubbaiti nahāpitapubbau, pubbai nahāpitau hutvā idāni bhikkhubhūtauti atthau| taina nahāpitapubbaina bhikkhunā| khurabhaṇḍanti khurādinahāpitabhaṇḍaṃ, ‘‘laddhātapattau rājakumārau’’tiādīsu viya upalakkhaṇanayauyaṃ| ‘‘na, bhikkhavai, pabbajitaina akappiyaṃ samādapaitabbaṃ, yau samādapaiyya, āpatti duk‍kaṭassa| na ca, bhikkhavai, nahāpitapubbaina khurabhaṇḍaṃ pariharitabbaṃ, yau pariharaiyya, āpatti duk‍kaṭassā’’ti (mahāva॰ 303) ca dvidhā pañ‍ñatti, tasmā nahāpitapubbaina vā anahāpitapubbaina vā pabbajitaina nāma akappiyasamādapanaṃ na kātabbaṃ| nahāpitapubbaina pana bhikkhunā khuraina abhilakkhitaṃ khurabhaṇḍaṃ, khurabhaṇḍakhurakausanisitapāsāṇakhurathavikādayau na pariharitabbā aiva| saisaṃ aṭṭhakathāyaṃ vuttanayainaiva vaiditabbaṃ| vajirabuddhiṭīkāyaṃ (vajira॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 300) pana ‘‘na, bhikkhavai, pabbajitaina akappiyai samādapaitabbanti vuttattā anupasampan‍nassapi na kaivalaṃ dasasu aiva sikkhāpadaisu, atha khau yaṃ bhikkhussa na kappati, tasmimpīti adhippāyau’’ti vuttaṃ|

dasabhāgakathā

65. dasabhāgakathāyaṃ saṅghikānīti saṅghasantakāni bījāni| puggalikāyāti puggalassa santakāya bhūmiyā| bhāgaṃ datvāti  mūlabhāgasaṅkhātaṃ dasamabhāgaṃ bhūmisāmikānaṃ datvā| paribhuñ‍jitabbānīti taisaṃ bījānaṃ phalāni raupakaihi paribhuñ‍jitabbānīti atthau| saisaṃ suviñ‍ñaiyyamaiva| idaṃ kira jambudīpai paurāṇakacārittanti ādikappakālai paṭhamakappikā manussā baudhisattaṃ mahāsammataṃ nāma rājānaṃ katvā sabbaipi attanau attanau taṇḍulaphalasālikhaittatau pavattataṇḍulaphalāni dasa kauṭṭhāsai katvā aikaṃ kauṭṭhāsaṃ bhūmisāmikabhūtassa mahāsammatarājinau datvā paribhuñ‍jiṃsu| tatau paṭṭhāya jambudīpikānaṃ manussānaṃ cāritattā vuttaṃ| tainaiva sāratthadīpanīnāmikāyampi vinayaṭīkāyaṃ (vajira॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 304) ‘‘dasabhāgaṃ datvāti dasamabhāgaṃ datvā| tainaivāha ‘dasa kauṭṭhāsai katvā aikau kauṭṭhāsau bhūmisāmikānaṃ dātabbau’ti’’ vuttaṃ|

pāthaiyyakathā

66. pāthaiyyakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai’’tiādi bhaddiyanagarai amitaparibhaugabhūtaina maiṇḍakasaiṭṭhinā abhiyācitau hutvā anuñ‍ñātaṃ, idha pana paṭhamaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, pañ‍ca gaurasai khīraṃ dadhiṃ tak‍kaṃ navanītaṃ sappi’’nti (mahāva॰ 299) pañ‍ca gaurasā anuñ‍ñātā| tatau paraṃ saiṭṭhinau abhiyācanānurūpaṃ vatvā anujānituṃ ‘‘santi, bhikkhavai, maggā kantārā’’tiādimāha| saisaṃ aṭṭhakathāyaṃ vuttanayainaiva vaiditabbaṃ| tathā alabhantaina añ‍ñātakaappavāritaṭṭhānatau yācitvāpi gahaitabbanti aitaina aivarūpaisu kālaisu viñ‍ñattipac‍cayā dausau natthīti dassaiti| ‘‘aikadivasaina gamanīyai maggai aikabhattatthāya pariyaisitabba’’nti vuttattā pana tatau upari yācanaṃ na vaṭṭatīti dassitaṃ| ‘‘dīghai addhānai’’tiādinā sacai māsagamanīyai  maggai sattāhagamanīyau aiva kantārau hauti, tattha sattāhayāpanīyamattamaiva pāthaiyyaṃ pariyaisitabbaṃ, tatau paraṃ piṇḍacārikādivasaina subhikkhasulabhapiṇḍamaggattā na pariyaisitabbanti|

mahāpadaisakathā

67. mahāpadaisakathāyaṃ mahāpadaisā nāma appaṭikkhittā dvai, ananuñ‍ñātā dvaiti cattārauti dassaintau ‘‘yaṃ bhikkhavai’’tiādimāha| taisu appaṭikkhittaipi akappiyānulaumakappiyānulaumavasaina dvai, tathā ananuñ‍ñātaipīti|

tattha  ‘‘parimaddantāti upaparikkhantā| paṭṭaṇṇudaisai sañ‍jātavatthaṃ paṭṭuṇṇaṃ| ‘paṭṭuṇṇaṃ kausaiyyavisaisau’ti hi abhidhānakausai vuttaṃ| cīnadaisai saumāradaisai ca sañ‍jātavatthāni cīnasaumārapaṭāni| paṭṭuṇṇādīni tīṇi kausaiyyassa anulaumāni pāṇakaihi katasuttamayattā| iddhimayaṃ aihibhikkhūnaṃ puñ‍ñiddhiyā nibbattacīvaraṃ, taṃ khaumādīnaṃ añ‍ñataraṃ hautīti taisaṃyaiva anulaumaṃ| daivatāhi din‍nacīvaraṃ daivadattiyaṃ, taṃ kapparukkhai nibbattaṃ jāliniyā daivakañ‍ñāya anuruddhatthairassa din‍navatthasadisaṃ, tampi khaumādīnaṃyaiva anulaumaṃ hauti taisu añ‍ñatarabhāvatau| dvai paṭāni daisanāmaina vuttānīti taisaṃ sarūpadassanamattamaitaṃ, nāñ‍ñanivattanapadaṃ paṭṭuṇṇapaṭṭassapi daisanāmainaiva vuttattā| tumbāti tīṇi bhājanāni| phalakatumbau lābuādi| udakatumbau udakukkhipanakuṭakau| kilañ‍jacchattanti vaiḷuvilīvaihi vāyitvā katachatta’’nti sāratthadīpaniyaṃ (sārattha॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 3.305) vuttaṃ|

‘‘yāvakālikapak‍kānanti  pak‍kai sandhāya vuttaṃ| āmāni pana anupasampan‍naihi sītudakai madditvā parissāvaitvā din‍napānaṃ pacchābhattampi kappati aiva| ayañ‍ca atthau mahāaṭṭhakathāyaṃ sarūpatau avuttauti āha ‘kurundiyaṃ panā’tiādi| ucchurasau nikasaṭauti idaṃ pātabbatāsāmañ‍ñaina yāmakālikakathāyaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ pana sattāhakālikamaivāti gahaitabbaṃ| imai cattārau rasāti phalapattapupphaucchurasā cattārau’’ti vimativinaudaniyaṃ (vi॰ vi॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 2.300) vuttaṃ| ‘‘dvai paṭā daisanāmainaivāti cīnapaṭasaumārapaṭāni| tīṇīti paṭṭuṇṇaina saha tīṇi| iddhimayaṃ aihibhikkhūnaṃ nibbattaṃ| daivadattiyaṃ anuruddhatthairaina laddha’’nti vajirabuddhiṭīkāyaṃ (vajira॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 305)|

saṃsaṭṭhakathā

saṃsaṭṭhakathāyaṃ tadahupaṭiggahitaṃ kālai kappatītiādi sabbaṃ sambhin‍narasaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ| sacai hi chal‍limpi apanaitvā sakalainaiva nāḷikairaphalaina saddhiṃ pānakaṃ paṭiggahitaṃ hauti, nāḷikairaṃ apanaitvā taṃ vikālaipi kappati| upari sappipiṇḍaṃ ṭhapaitvā sītalapāyāsaṃ dainti, yaṃ pāyāsaina asaṃsaṭṭhaṃ sappi, taṃ apanaitvā sattāhaṃ paribhuñ‍jituṃ vaṭṭati| baddhamadhuphāṇitādīsupi aisaiva nayau| tak‍kaulajātiphalādīhi alaṅkaritvā piṇḍapātaṃ dainti, tāni uddharitvā dhauvitvā yāvajīvaṃ paribhuñ‍jitabbāni, yāguyaṃ pakkhipitvā din‍nasiṅgivairādīsupi, tailādīsu pakkhipitvā din‍nalaṭṭhimadhukādīsupi  aisaiva nayau| aivaṃ yaṃ yaṃ asambhin‍narasaṃ hauti, taṃ taṃ aikatau paṭiggahitampi yathā suddhaṃ hauti, tathā dhauvitvā vā tacchaitvā vā tassa tassa kālassa vasaina paribhuñ‍jituṃ vaṭṭati|

sacai  pana sambhin‍narasaṃ hauti saṃsaṭṭhaṃ, na vaṭṭati| yāvakālikañhi attanā saddhiṃ sambhin‍narasāni tīṇipi yāmakālikādīni attanau sabhāvaṃ upanaiti| yāmakālikaṃ dvaipi sattāhakālikādīni attanau sabhāvaṃ upanaiti| sattāhakālikaṃ attanā saddhiṃ saṃsaṭṭhaṃ yāvajīvikaṃ attanau sabhāvañ‍ñaiva upanaiti, tasmā taina tadahupaṭiggahitaina saddhiṃ tadahupaṭiggahitaṃ vā puraipaṭiggahitaṃ vā yāvajīvikaṃ sattāhaṃ kappati, dvīhapaṭiggahitaina chāhaṃ…pai॰… sattāhapaṭiggahitaina tadahaiva kappatīti vaiditabbaṃ| tasmāyaiva hi ‘‘sattāhakālikaina, bhikkhavai, yāvajīvikaṃ tadahupaṭiggahita’’nti avatvā ‘‘paṭiggahitaṃ sattāhaṃ kappatī’’ti vuttaṃ|

kālayāmasattāhātik‍kamaisu caittha vikālabhaujanasan‍nidhibhaisaj‍jasikkhāpadānaṃ vasaina āpattiyau vaiditabbā| imaisu ca pana catūsu kālikaisu yāvakālikaṃ yāmakālikanti idamaiva dvayaṃ antauvutthakañ‍caiva san‍nidhikārakañ‍ca hauti, sattāhakālikañ‍ca yāvajīvikañ‍ca akappiyakuṭiyaṃ nikkhipitumpi vaṭṭati, san‍nidhimpi na janaitīti| saisaṃ sabbattha uttānatthamaiva|

pañ‍cabhaisaj‍jakathā

pañ‍cabhaisaj‍jakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, tāni pañ‍ca bhaisaj‍jāni kālai paṭiggahaitvā kālai paribhuñ‍jitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 261) vacanatau sāradikaina ābādhaina phuṭṭhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yāgupi pītā uggacchati, bhattampi bhuttaṃ uggacchati, tai taina kisā haunti lūkhā dubbaṇṇā uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātā dhamanisanthatagattā| taisaṃ yaṃ bhaisaj‍jañ‍caiva assa bhaisaj‍jasammatañ‍ca, laukassa āhāratthañ‍ca pharaiyya, na ca auḷārikau āhārau  pañ‍ñāyaiyya| tatrimāni pañ‍ca bhaisaj‍jāni| saiyyathidaṃ – sappi navanītaṃ tailaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, tāni bhaisaj‍jāni kālai paṭiggahaitvā kālai paribhuñ‍jituṃ vaṭṭati| tattha ‘‘sāradikaina ābādhaināti saradakālai uppan‍naina pittābādhaina| tasmiñhi kālai vassaudakainapi taimainti, kaddamampi maddanti, antarantarā  ābādhaupi kharau hauti, taina taisaṃ pittaṃ kauṭṭhabbhantaragataṃ hauti| āhāratthañ‍ca pharaiyyāti āhāratthaṃ sādhaiyyā’’ti aṭṭhakathāyaṃ (mahāva॰ aṭṭha॰ 260) vuttaṃ| vimativinaudaniyaṃ (vi॰ vi॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 2.260) ‘‘pittaṃ kauṭṭhabbhantaragataṃ hautīti bahisarīrai byāpaitvā ṭhitaṃ abaddhapittaṃ kauṭṭhabbhantaragataṃ hauti, taina pittaṃ kupitaṃ hautīti adhippāyau’’ti vuttaṃ|

vajirabuddhiṭīkāyaṃ (vajira॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 260) ‘‘yaṃ bhaisaj‍jañ‍caiva assāti paratau ‘tadubhayaina bhiyyausaumattāya kisā hauntī’tiādinā viraudhadassanatau nidānānapaikkhaṃ yathālābhavasaina vuttanti vaiditabbaṃ| yathānidānaṃ kasmā na vuttanti cai? tadañ‍ñāpaikkhādhippāyatau| sabbabuddhakālaipi hi sappiādīnaṃ sattāhakālikabhāvāpaikkhauti| tathā vacanaina bhagavatau adhippāyau| tainaiva ‘āhāratthañ‍ca pharaiyya, na ca auḷārikau āhārau pañ‍ñāyaiyyā’ti vuttaṃ| tathā hi kālai paṭiggahaitvā kālai paribhuñ‍jitunti aittha ca kālaparicchaidau na katau, kutauyaiva pana labbhā tadañ‍ñāpaikkhādhippāyau bhagavatā mūlabhaisaj‍jādīni tāni paṭiggahaitvā yāvajīvanti kālaparicchaidau| yaṃ pana ‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, tāni bhaisaj‍jāni kālai paṭiggahaitvā kālai paribhuñ‍jitu’nti (mahāva॰ 260) vacanaṃ, taṃ ‘san‍nidhiṃ katvā aparāparasmiṃ divasai kālai aiva paribhuñ‍jituṃ anujānāmī’ti adhippāyatau vuttanti vaiditabbaṃ| añ‍ñathā atisayattā bhagavatau  ‘yaṃ bhaisaj‍jañ‍caiva assā’tiādivitak‍kuppādau na sambhavati| paṇītabhaujanānumatiyā pasiddhattā ābādhānurūpasappāyāpaikkhāya vuttānīti cai? tañ‍ca na, ‘bhiyyausaumattāyā’ti kisādibhāvāpattidassanatau| yathā ucchurasaṃ upādāya phāṇitanti vuttaṃ, tathā navanītaṃ upādāya sappīti vattabbatau navanītaṃ visuṃ na vattabbanti cai? na visaisadassanādhippāyatau| yathā phāṇitaggahaṇaina siddhaipi paratau ucchurasau visuṃ anuñ‍ñātau ucchusāmañ‍ñatau guḷaudakaṭṭhānai ṭhapanādhippāyatau, tathā navanītai visaisavidhidassanādhippāyatau navanītaṃ visuṃ anuñ‍ñātanti vaiditabbaṃ| visaisavidhi panassa bhaisaj‍jasikkhāpadaṭṭhakathāvasaina (pārā॰ aṭṭha॰ 2.619-621) vaiditabbau| vuttañhi tattha ‘pacitvā sappiṃ katvā paribhuñ‍jitukāmaina adhautampi pacituṃ vaṭṭatī’ti| tattha sappi pak‍kāva hauti, nāpak‍kā, tathā phāṇitampi| navanītaṃ apak‍kamaivā’’tiādi|

dutiyabhaisaj‍jakathā

dutiyabhaisaj‍jakathāyaṃ  ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, tāni pañ‍ca bhaisaj‍jāni paṭiggahaitvā kālaipi vikālaipi paribhuñ‍jitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 261) vacanatau ‘‘tāni pañ‍ca bhaisaj‍jāni kālai paṭiggahaitvā kālai paribhuñ‍jantānaṃ taisaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ yānipi tāni pākatikāni lūkhāni bhaujanāni, tāni nacchādainti, pagaiva sainaisitāni| tai taina caiva sāradikaina ābādhaina phuṭṭhā iminā ca bhattācchādakaina tadubhayaina bhiyyausaumattāya kisā hauntī’’ti imasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ kālaipi vikālaipīti anuñ‍ñātattā vikālaipi paribhuñ‍jituṃ vaṭṭati| tattha ‘‘nacchādaintīti na jīranti, na vātaraugaṃ paṭippassambhaituṃ sak‍kaunti| sainaisitānīti siniddhāni| bhattācchādakaināti  bhattaṃ araucikainā’’ti aṭṭhakathāyaṃ (mahāva॰ aṭṭha॰ 261) vuttaṃ, ṭīkāsu (sārattha॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 3.261; vi॰ vi॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 2.261-262) pana ‘‘nacchādaintīti ruciṃ na uppādaintī’’ti aittakamaiva vuttaṃ, mahāvibhaṅgai (pārā॰ 622) pana ‘‘yāni khau pana tāni gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭisāyanīyāni bhaisaj‍jāni| saiyyathidaṃ – sappi navanītaṃ tailaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, tāni paṭiggahaitvā sattāhaparamaṃ san‍nidhikārakaṃ paribhuñ‍jitabbāni, taṃ atik‍kāmayatau nissaggiyaṃ pācittiya’’nti vacanatau imaisaṃ pañ‍cabhaisaj‍jānaṃ sattāhakālikabhāvau vaiditabbau, idha pana aṭṭhuppattivasaina vuttauti|

vasābhaisaj‍jakathā

vasābhaisaj‍jakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, vasāni bhaisaj‍jāni acchavasaṃ macchavasaṃ susukāvasaṃ sūkaravasaṃ gadrabhavasaṃ kālai paṭiggahitaṃ kālai nippak‍kaṃ kālai saṃsaṭṭhaṃ tailaparibhaugaina paribhuñ‍jituṃ| vikālai cai, bhikkhavai, paṭiggahitaṃ vikālai nippak‍kaṃ vikālai saṃsaṭṭhaṃ, tañ‍cai paribhuñ‍jaiyya, āpatti tiṇṇaṃ duk‍kaṭānaṃ| kālai cai, bhikkhavai, paṭiggahitaṃ vikālai nippak‍kaṃ vikālai saṃsaṭṭhaṃ, tañ‍cai paribhuñ‍jaiyya, āpatti dvin‍naṃ duk‍kaṭānaṃ| kālai cai, bhikkhavai, paṭiggahitaṃ kālai nippak‍kaṃ vikālai saṃsaṭṭhaṃ, tañ‍cai paribhuñ‍jaiyya, āpatti duk‍kaṭassa| kālai cai, bhikkhavai, paṭiggahitaṃ kālai nippak‍kaṃ kālai saṃsaṭṭhaṃ, tañ‍cai paribhuñ‍jaiyya, anāpattī’’ti (mahāva॰ 262)| tattha ‘‘kālai paṭiggahitantiādīsu majjhanhikai avītivattai paṭiggahaitvā pacitvā parissāvaitvā cāti atthau| tailaparibhaugaina paribhuñ‍jitunti  sattāhakālikatailaparibhaugaina paribhuñ‍jitu’’nti aṭṭhakathāyaṃ (mahāva॰ aṭṭha॰ 262) vuttaṃ, ṭīkāsu (sārattha॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 3.262; vi॰ vi॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 2.261-262) pana ‘‘susukāti  samuddai bhavā aikā macchajāti, kumbhilātipi vadanti| saṃsaṭṭhanti parissāvitaṃ| tailaparibhaugaināti sattāhakālikaparibhaugaṃ sandhāya vutta’’nti vuttaṃ| ayamaittha saṅkhaipau, vitthārau pana haiṭṭhā catukālikakathāyaṃ vuttauyaiva|

mūlabhaisaj‍jakathā

mūlabhaisaj‍jakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, mūlāni bhaisaj‍jāni, haliddiṃ siṅgivairaṃ vacaṃ vacattaṃ ativisaṃ kaṭukarauhiṇiṃ usīraṃ bhaddamuttakaṃ, yāni vā panañ‍ñānipi atthi mūlāni bhaisaj‍jāni naiva khādanīyai khādanīyatthaṃ pharanti, na bhaujanīyai bhaujanīyatthaṃ pharanti, tāni paṭiggahaitvā yāvajīvaṃ pariharituṃ, sati pac‍cayai paribhuñ‍jituṃ| asati pac‍cayai paribhuñ‍jantassa āpatti duk‍kaṭassā’’ti| tattha vacattanti saitavacaṃ| saisaṃ haiṭṭhā vuttamaiva|

piṭṭhabhaisaj‍jakathā

piṭṭhabhaisaj‍jakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, nisadaṃ nisadapautaka’’nti (mahāva॰ 263) vacanatau pisitaihi cuṇṇakataihi mūlabhaisaj‍jaihi atthai sati nisadañ‍ca nisadapautakañ‍ca pariharituṃ vaṭṭati| tattha nisadaṃ nisadapautakanti pisanasilā ca pisanapautau ca| nisadanti pisanti cuṇṇavicuṇṇaṃ karaunti mūlabhaisaj‍jādayau aitthāti nisadaṃ, pisanasilā| nisadanti pisanti cuṇṇavicuṇṇaṃ karaunti mūlabhaisaj‍jādayau aitaināti nisadaṃ, pausaitabbauti pautau, dārakau| khuddakappamāṇatāya pautau viyāti pautau, nisadañ‍ca taṃ pautau cāti nisadapautau, taṃ nisadapautakaṃ| nipubbasada cuṇṇakaraṇaiti dhātu|

kasāvabhaisaj‍jakathā

kasāvabhaisaj‍jakathāyaṃ  ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, kasāvāni bhaisaj‍jāni nimbakasāvaṃ kuṭajakasāvaṃ paṭaulakasāvaṃ phaggavakasāvaṃ nattamālakasāvaṃ, yāni vā panañ‍ñānipi atthi kasāvāni  bhaisaj‍jāni naiva khādanīyai khādanīyatthaṃ pharanti, na bhaujanīyai bhaujanīyatthaṃ pharanti, tāni paṭiggahaitvā yāvajīvaṃ pariharituṃ, sati pac‍cayai paribhuñ‍jituṃ, asati pac‍cayai paribhuñ‍jantassa āpatti duk‍kaṭassā’’ti (mahāva॰ 263) vacanatau tānipi kasāvabhaisaj‍jāni paṭiggahaitvā yāvajīvaṃ pariharituṃ sati pac‍cayai paribhuñ‍jituṃ vaṭṭati| tattha phaggavanti latājāti| nattamālanti karañ‍jaṃ| ‘‘kasāvaihīti tacādīni udakai tāpaitvā gahitaūsaraihī’’ti vimativinaudaniyaṃ (vi॰ vi॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 2.263) vuttaṃ|

paṇṇabhaisaj‍jakathā

paṇṇabhaisaj‍jakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, paṇṇāni bhaisaj‍jāni nimbapaṇṇaṃ kuṭajapaṇṇaṃ paṭaulapaṇṇaṃ nattamālapaṇṇaṃ phaggavapaṇṇaṃ sulasipaṇṇaṃ kappāsapaṇṇaṃ, yāni vā panañ‍ñānipi atthi paṇṇāni bhaisaj‍jāni naiva khādanīyai khādanīyatthaṃ pharanti, na bhaujanīyai bhaujanīyatthaṃ pharanti, tāni paṭiggahaitvā yāvajīvaṃ pariharituṃ, sati pac‍cayai paribhuñ‍jituṃ, asati pac‍cayai paribhuñ‍jantassa āpatti duk‍kaṭassā’’ti (mahāva॰ 263) vacanatau khādanīyabhaujanīyatthaṃ apharantāni tānipi paṇṇāni paṭiggahaitvā yāvajīvaṃ pariharituṃ, sati pac‍cayai paribhuñ‍jituṃ vaṭṭati| acchavasantiādīsu nissaggiyavaṇṇanāyaṃ (pārā॰ aṭṭha॰ 2.623) vuttanayainaiva atthau vaiditabbau| mūlabhaisaj‍jādivinicchayaupi khuddakavaṇṇanāyaṃ vuttauyaiva, tasmā idha yaṃ yaṃ pubbai avuttaṃ, taṃ tadaiva vaṇṇayissāma|

phalabhaisaj‍jakathā

phalabhaisaj‍jakathāyaṃ  ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, phalāni bhaisaj‍jāni biḷaṅgaṃ pippaliṃ maricaṃ harītakaṃ vibhītakaṃ āmalakaṃ gauṭṭhaphalaṃ, yāni vā panañ‍ñānipi atthi phalāni bhaisaj‍jāni naiva khādanīyai khādanīyatthaṃ pharanti, na bhaujanīyai bhaujanīyatthaṃ pharanti, tāni paṭiggahaitvā yāvajīvaṃ pariharituṃ, sati pac‍cayai paribhuñ‍jituṃ, asati pac‍cayai paribhuñ‍jantassa āpatti duk‍kaṭassā’’ti (mahāva॰ 263) vacanatau khādanīyabhaujanīyatthaṃ apharantāni tāni phalāni paṭiggahaitvā yāvajīvaṃ pariharituṃ, sati pac‍cayai paribhuñ‍jitumpi vaṭṭati|

jatubhaisaj‍jakathā

jatubhaisaj‍jakathāyaṃ  ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, jatūni bhaisaj‍jāni hiṅguṃ hiṅgujatuṃ hiṅgusipāṭikaṃ takaṃ takapattiṃ takapaṇṇiṃ saj‍julasaṃ, yāni vā panañ‍ñānipi atthi jatūni bhaisaj‍jāni naiva khādanīyai khādanīyatthaṃ pharanti, na bhaujanīyai bhaujanīyatthaṃ pharanti, tāni paṭiggahaitvā yāvajīvaṃ pariharituṃ, sati pac‍cayai paribhuñ‍jituṃ, asati pac‍cayai paribhuñ‍jantassa āpatti duk‍kaṭassā’’ti (mahāva॰ 263) vacanatau tāni jatūni bhaisaj‍jāni paṭiggahaitvā yāvajīvaṃ pariharituṃ, sati pac‍cayai paribhuñ‍jituṃ vaṭṭati| tattha hiṅguhiṅgujatuhiṅgusipāṭikā hiṅgujātiyauyaiva| takatakapattitakapaṇṇayau lākhājātiyau|

vajirabuddhiṭīkāyaṃ (vajira॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 263) pana ‘‘hiṅgujatu nāma hiṅgurukkhassa daṇḍapal‍lavapavāḷapākanipphan‍nā| hiṅgusipāṭikā nāma tassa mūlasākhapākanipphan‍nā| takaṃ nāma tassa rukkhassa tacapākaudakaṃ| takapattīti tassa pattapākaudakaṃ| takapaṇṇīti tassa phalapākaudakaṃ| atha vā ‘takaṃ nāma lākhā| takapattīti kittimalauhasākhā| takapaṇṇīti pak‍kalākhā’ti likhitaṃ| sati pac‍cayaiti aittha satipac‍cayatā gilānāgilānavasaina dvidhā vaiditabbā| vikālabhaujanasikkhāpadassa hi anāpattivārai yāmakālikādīnaṃ tiṇṇampi avisaisaina satipac‍cayatā vuttā| imasmiṃ khandhakai ‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, gilānassa guḷaṃ agilānassa guḷaudakaṃ| anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, gilānassa lauṇasauvīrakaṃ, agilānassa udakasambhin‍na’nti (mahāva॰ 273) vuttaṃ, tasmā siddhaṃ ‘satipac‍cayatā gilānāgilānavasaina duvidhā’ti, añ‍ñathā asati pac‍cayai guḷaudakādi āpaj‍jati, tatau ca pāḷiviraudhau| āhāratthanti āhārapayaujanaṃ, āhārakic‍cayāpananti atthauti ca| tailaparibhaugaināti sattāhakālikaparibhaugaina| piṭṭhaihīti pisitatailaihi| kauṭṭhaphalanti kauṭṭharukkhassa phalaṃ, madanaphalaṃ vāti ca likhita’’nti vuttaṃ|

lauṇabhaisaj‍jakathā

lauṇabhaisaj‍jakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, lauṇāni bhaisaj‍jāni sāmuddikaṃ kāḷalauṇaṃ sindhavaṃ ubbhidaṃ bilaṃ, yāni vā panañ‍ñānipi atthi lauṇāni bhaisaj‍jāni naiva khādanīyai khādanīyatthaṃ  pharanti, na bhaujanīyai bhaujanīyatthaṃ pharanti, tāni paṭiggahaitvā yāvajīvaṃ pariharituṃ, sati pac‍cayai paribhuñ‍jituṃ, asati pac‍cayai paribhuñ‍jantassa āpatti duk‍kaṭassā’’ti (mahāva॰ 263) vacanatau tāni lauṇāni paṭiggahaitvā yāvajīvaṃ pariharituṃ, sati pac‍cayai paribhuñ‍jituṃ vaṭṭati| tattha sāmuddanti samuddatīrai vālukaṃ viya santiṭṭhati| kāḷalauṇanti pakatilauṇaṃ| sindhavanti saitavaṇṇaṃ pabbatai uṭṭhahati| ubbhidanti bhūmitau aṅkuraṃ viya uṭṭhahati| bilanti dabbasambhāraihi saddhiṃ pacitaṃ, taṃ rattavaṇṇaṃ| sāratthadīpaniyaṃ (sārattha॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 3.263) pana ‘‘ubbhidaṃ nāma ūsarapaṃsumaya’’nti  vuttaṃ| vimativinaudaniyaṃ (vi॰ vi॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 2.263) pana ‘‘ubbhidanti ūsarapaṃsumayaṃ lauṇaṃ| bilanti lauṇavisaisau’’ti vuttaṃ| vajirabuddhiṭīkāyampi tathaiva vuttaṃ|

cuṇṇakathā

cuṇṇakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, yassa kaṇḍu vā pīḷakā vā assāvau vā thul‍lakacchu vā ābādhau kāyau vā duggandhau cuṇṇāni bhaisaj‍jāni, agilānassa chakaṇaṃ mattikaṃ rajananippak‍kaṃ| anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, udukkhalaṃ musala’’nti (mahāva॰ 264)| ‘‘kāyau vā duggandhauti kassaci assādīnaṃ viya kāyagandhau hauti, tassapi sirīsakausumbādicuṇṇāni vā gandhacuṇṇāni vā sabbāni vaṭṭanti| chakaṇanti gaumayaṃ| rajananippak‍kanti rajanakasaṭaṃ, pākatikacuṇṇampi kauṭṭaitvā udakaina taimaitvā nhāyituṃ vaṭṭati, aitampi rajananippak‍kasaṅkhamaiva gacchatī’’ti aṭṭhakathāyaṃ (mahāva॰ aṭṭha॰ 264) vuttaṃ| sāratthadīpaniyaṃ (sārattha॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 3.264) pana ‘‘chakaṇanti gaumayaṃ| pākatikacuṇṇaṃ nāma apak‍kakasāvacuṇṇaṃ| taina ṭhapaitvā gandhacuṇṇaṃ sabbaṃ vaṭṭatīti vadantī’’ti vuttaṃ| vimativinaudaniyampi (vi॰ vi॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 2.264-265) ‘‘chakaṇanti gaumayaṃ| pākatikacuṇṇanti apak‍kakasāvacuṇṇaṃ, gandhacuṇṇaṃ pana na vaṭṭatī’’ti vuttaṃ| vajirabuddhiṭīkāyampi (vajira॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 264) ‘‘chakaṇanti gaumayaṃ| pākatikacuṇṇaṃ nāma apak‍kakasāvacuṇṇaṃ| taina ṭhapaitvā gandhacuṇṇaṃ sabbaṃ vaṭṭatīti vadantī’’ti vuttaṃ| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, cuṇṇacālini’’nti (mahāva॰ 264) vacanatau gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cuṇṇaihi bhaisaj‍jaihi cālitaihi atthai sati cuṇṇacālinī vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, dussacālini’’nti (mahāva॰ 264) vacanatau saṇhaihi cuṇṇaihi atthai sati dussacālinī vaṭṭati| ‘‘cuṇṇacālininti udukkhalai kauṭṭitacuṇṇaparissāvani’’nti vimativinaudaniyaṃ  (vi॰ vi॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 2.264-265) vuttaṃ| vajirabuddhiṭīkāyampi (vajira॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 264) ‘‘cālitaihīti parissāvitaihī’’ti vuttaṃ|

amanussikābādhakathā

amanussikābādhakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, amanussikābādhai āmakamaṃsaṃ āmakamaṃsalauhita’’nti (mahāva॰ 264) vacanatau yassa bhikkhunau āmakamaṃsaṃ khāditassa āmakalauhitaṃ pivitassa sau amanussābādhau paṭippassambhati, tassa anāpatti| tattha āmakamaṃsañ‍ca khādi, āmakalauhitañ‍ca pivīti na taṃ bhikkhu khādi, na pivi, amanussau khāditvā ca pivitvā ca pak‍kantau| taina vuttaṃ ‘‘tassa sau amanussikābādhau paṭippassambhī’’ti|

añ‍janakathā

añ‍janakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, añ‍janaṃ kāḷañ‍janaṃ rasañ‍janaṃ sautañ‍janaṃ gairukaṃ kapal‍la’’nti (mahāva॰ 265) vacanatau bhikkhūnaṃ cakkhuraugai sati añ‍janādīni vaṭṭanti| tattha ‘‘añ‍jananti sabbasaṅgāhikavacanamaitaṃ| kāḷañ‍jananti aikā añ‍janajāti| rasañ‍jananti nānāsambhāraihi kataṃ| sautañ‍jananti nadīsautādīsu uppaj‍janakaañ‍janaṃ| gairukau nāma suvaṇṇagairukau| kapal‍lanti dīpasikhatau gahitamasī’’ti aṭṭhakathāyaṃ (mahāva॰ aṭṭha॰ 264) vuttaṃ| sāratthadīpaniyaṃ (sārattha॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 3.265) ‘‘suvaṇṇagairukauti suvaṇṇatutthādī’’ti vuttaṃ| vimativinaudaniyampi (vi॰ vi॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 2.264-265) tathaiva vuttaṃ| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, candanaṃ tagaraṃ kāḷānusāriyaṃ tālīsaṃ bhaddamuttaka’’nti (mahāva॰ 265) vacanatau añ‍janūpapisanaihi atthai sati imāni candanādīni vaṭṭanti| tattha ‘‘candananti lauhitacandanādikaṃ yaṃ kiñ‍ci candanaṃ| tagarādīni  pākaṭāni| añ‍ñānipi nīluppalādīni vaṭṭantiyaiva| añ‍janūpapisanaihīti añ‍janaihi saddhiṃ aikatau pisitabbaihi| na hi kiñ‍ci añ‍janūpapisanaṃ na vaṭṭatī’’ti aṭṭhakathāyaṃ (mahāva॰ aṭṭha॰ 264) ṭīkāyaṃ (sārattha॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 3.265) pana ‘‘añ‍janūpapisananti añ‍janatthāya upapisitabbaṃ yaṃ kiñ‍ci  cuṇṇajātī’’ti vuttaṃ| vimativinaudaniyaṃ (vi॰ vi॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 2.264-265) pana ‘‘pāḷiyaṃ añ‍janūpapisananti añ‍janai upanaituṃ pisitabbabhaisaj‍ja’’nti vuttaṃ|

‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, añ‍jani’’nti (mahāva॰ 265) vacanatau añ‍janaṭhapanaṭṭhānaṃ vaṭṭati| ‘‘na, bhikkhavai, uc‍cāvacā añ‍janī dhāraitabbā, yau dhāraiyya, āpatti duk‍kaṭassa| anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, aṭṭhimayaṃ dantamayaṃ visāṇamayaṃ naḷamayaṃ vaiḷumayaṃ kaṭṭhamayaṃ jatumayaṃ lauhamayaṃ saṅkhanābhimaya’’nti (mahāva॰ 265) vacanatau aitāni kappiyāni| tattha aṭṭhimayanti manussaṭṭhiṃ ṭhapaitvā avasaisaaṭṭhimayaṃ| dantamayanti hatthidantādisabbadantamayaṃ| visāṇamayaipi akappiyaṃ nāma natthi| naḷamayādayau aikantakappiyāyaiva|

‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, apidhāna’’nti (mahāva॰ 265) vacanatau añ‍janīapidhānampi vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, suttakaina bandhitvā añ‍janiyā bandhitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 265) vacanatau apidhānaṃ suttakaina bandhitvā añ‍janiyā bandhitabbaṃ| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, suttakaina sibbaitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 265) vacanatau apatanatthāya añ‍janīsuttakaina sibbaituṃ vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, añ‍janisalāka’’nti (mahāva॰ 265) vacanatau añ‍janisalākampi vaṭṭati| ‘‘na, bhikkhavai, uc‍cāvacā añ‍janisalākā dhāraitabbā, yau dhāraiyya, āpatti duk‍kaṭassa| anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, aṭṭhimayaṃ…pai॰… saṅkhanābhimaya’’nti (mahāva॰ 265) vacanatau aitāyaiva añ‍janisalākā vaṭṭanti| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, salākaṭṭhāniya’’nti (mahāva॰ 265) vacanatau añ‍janisalākaṭṭhāniyampi vaṭṭati| tattha salākaṭṭhāniyanti yattha salākaṃ audahanti, taṃ susiradaṇḍakaṃ vā thavikaṃ vā anujānāmīti  atthau| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, añ‍janitthavika’’nti (mahāva॰ 265) vacanatau thavikampi vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, aṃsabaddhakaṃ bandhanasuttaka’’nti (mahāva॰ 265) vacanatau añ‍janitthavikāya aṃsai lagganatthāya aṃsabaddhakampi bandhanasuttakampi vaṭṭati|

natthukathā

natthukathāyaṃ  ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, muddhani tailaka’’nti (mahāva॰ 266) vacanatau sīsābhitāpassa bhikkhunau muddhani tailaṃ vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, natthukamma’’nti (mahāva॰ 266) vacanatau nakkhamanīyai sati natthukammaṃ vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, natthukaraṇi’’nti (mahāva॰ 266) vacanatau natthuyā agaḷanatthaṃ natthukaraṇī vaṭṭati| ‘‘na, bhikkhavai, uc‍cāvacā natthukaraṇī dhāraitabbā, yau dhāraiyya, āpatti duk‍kaṭassa| anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, aṭṭhimayaṃ…pai॰… saṅkhanābhimaya’’nti (mahāva॰ 266) vacanatau aitāyaiva natthukaraṇiyau vaṭṭanti| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, yamakanatthukaraṇi’’nti (mahāva॰ 266) vacanatau natthu visamaṃ āsiñ‍cayanti cai, yamakanatthukaraṇiṃ dhāraitabbaṃ| tattha yamakanatthukaraṇinti samasau tāhi dvīhi panāḷikāhi aikaṃ natthukaraṇiṃ|

dhūmanaittakathā

dhūmanaittakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, dhūmaṃ pātu’’nti (mahāva॰ 266) vacanatau yamakanatthukaraṇiyā nakkhamanīyai sati dhūmaṃ pātuṃ vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, dhūmanaitta’’nti (mahāva॰ 266) vacanatau tamaiva vaṭṭiṃ ālimbaitvā pivanapac‍cayā kaṇṭhai dahantaina dhūmanaittadhūmau pivitabbau| ‘‘na, bhikkhavai, uc‍cāvacāni dhūmanaittāni dhāraitabbāni, yau dhāraiyya, āpatti duk‍kaṭassa| anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, aṭṭhimayaṃ…pai॰… saṅkhanābhimaya’’nti (mahāva॰ 266) vacanatau aitāni aiva dhūmanaittāni dhāraitabbāni| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, apidhāna’’nti (mahāva॰ 266) vacanatau pāṇakādiappavisanatthaṃ dhūmanaittatthavikampi vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, yamakatthavika’’nti (mahāva॰ 266) vacanatau aikatau ghaṃsiyamānai sati yamakatthavikaṃ vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, aṃsabaddhakaṃ bandhanasuttaka’’nti (mahāva॰ 266) vacanatau dhūmanaittatthavikassa aṃsabaddhabandhanasuttaṃ vaṭṭati|

tailapākakathā

tailapākakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, tailapāka’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau vātābādhai  sati tailapākau vaṭṭati| tattha anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, tailapākanti yaṃ kiñ‍ci bhaisaj‍japakkhittaṃ sabbaṃ anuñ‍ñātamaiva hauti| ‘‘na, bhikkhavai, atipakkhittamaj‍jaṃ tailaṃ pātabbaṃ, yau pivaiyya, yathādhammau kāraitabbau| anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, yasmiṃ tailapākai maj‍jassa na vaṇṇau na gandhau na rasau pañ‍ñāyati, aivarūpaṃ maj‍japakkhittaṃ tailaṃ pātu’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau yasmiṃ tailapākai pakkhittassa maj‍jassa vaṇṇau vā gandhau vā rasau vā na pañ‍ñāyati, tādisaṃ tailaṃ pivitabbaṃ| tattha atipakkhittamaj‍jānīti ativiya khittamaj‍jāni, bahuṃ maj‍jaṃ pakkhipitvā yaujitānīti atthau| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, abbhañ‍janaṃ adhiṭṭhātu’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau atipakkhittamaj‍jattā apivitabbai tailai sati abbhañ‍janaṃ adhiṭṭhātuṃ vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, tīṇi tumbāni lauhatumbaṃ kaṭṭhatumbaṃ phalatumba’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau tailapak‍kabhājanāni imāni tīṇi tumbāni vaṭṭanti|

saidakammakathā

saidakammakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, saidakamma’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau aṅgavātai sati saidakammaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati| tattha aṅgavātauti hatthapādai vātau| nakkhamanīyau hauti, ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, sambhārasaida’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau saidakammaina nakkhamanīyai sati sambhārasaidaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati| tattha sambhārasaidanti nānāvidhapaṇṇasambhārasaidaṃ| nakkhamanīyau hauti, ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, mahāsaida’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau sambhārasaidanakkhamanīyai sati mahāsaidaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati| tattha mahāsaidanti mahantaṃ saidaṃ, paurisappamāṇaṃ āvāṭaṃ aṅgārānaṃ pūraitvā paṃsuvālikādīhi pidahitvā tattha nānāvidhāni vātaharaṇapaṇṇāni santharitvā tailamakkhitaina gattaina tattha nipaj‍jitvā samparivattantaina sarīraṃ saidaituṃ anujānāmīti atthau| nakkhamanīyau hauti, ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, bhaṅgaudaka’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau mahāsaidaina nakkhamanīyai sati bhaṅgaudakaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati| tattha bhaṅgaudakanti nānāpaṇṇabhaṅgakuthitaṃ udakaṃ, taihi paṇṇaihi ca udakaina ca siñ‍citvā siñ‍citvā saidaitabbau| nakkhamanīyau hauti, ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, udakakauṭṭhaka’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau bhaṅgaudakaina nakkhamanīyai sati udakakauṭṭhakaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati| tattha udakakauṭṭhakanti  udakakauṭṭhai cāṭiṃ vā dauṇiṃ vā uṇhaudakassa pūraitvā tattha pavisitvā saidakammakaraṇaṃ anujānāmīti atthau|

lauhitamaucanakathā

lauhitamaucanakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, lauhitaṃ maucaitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau pabbavātai sati lauhitaṃ maucaituṃ vaṭṭati| tattha pabbavātau hautīti pabbai pabbai vātau vijjhati| lauhitaṃ maucaitunti satthakaina lauhitaṃ maucaituṃ| nakkhamanīyau hauti, anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, lauhitaṃ maucaitvā visāṇaina gāhaitunti (mahāva॰ 267)|

pādabbhañ‍janakathā

pādabbhañ‍janakathāyaṃ  ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, pādabbhañ‍jana’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau pādaisu phalitaisu pādabbhañ‍janaṃ pacitabbaṃ| nakkhamanīyau hauti, ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, paj‍jaṃ abhisaṅkharitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau pādabbhañ‍janatailaina nakkhamanīyai sati paj‍jaṃ abhisaṅkharitabbaṃ| tattha paj‍jaṃ abhisaṅkharitunti yaina phalitapādā pākatikā haunti, taṃ nāḷikairādīsu nānābhaisaj‍jāni pakkhipitvā paj‍jaṃ abhisaṅkharituṃ, pādānaṃ sappāyabhaisaj‍jaṃ pacitunti atthau|

gaṇḍābādhakathā

gaṇḍābādhakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, satthakamma’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau gaṇḍābādhai sati satthakammaṃ kātabbaṃ| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, kasāvaudaka’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau kasāvaudakaina atthai sati kasāvaudakaṃ dātabbaṃ| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, tilakak‍ka’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau tilakak‍kaina atthai sati tilakak‍kaṃ dātabbaṃ| tilakak‍kaina atthauti piṭṭhaihi tilaihi atthau| ‘‘anujānāmi bhikkhavai kabaḷika’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau kabaḷikāya atthai sati kabaḷikā dātabbā| tattha kabaḷikanti vaṇamukhai sattupiṇḍaṃ pakkhipituṃ| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, vaṇabandhanacauḷa’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau  vaṇabandhanacauḷaina atthai sati vaṇabandhanacauḷaṃ dātabbaṃ| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, sāsapakuṭṭaina phausitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau sacai vaṇau kuṇḍavatī, sāsapakuṭṭaina phausitabbaṃ| tattha sāsapakuṭṭaināti sāsapapiṭṭhaina|

‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, dhūmaṃ kātu’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau yadi vaṇau kilij‍jittha, dhūmaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, lauṇasakkharikāya chinditu’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau yadi vaḍḍhamaṃsaṃ vuṭṭhāti, chinditabbaṃ| tattha vaḍḍhamaṃsanti adhikamaṃsaṃ āṇī viya uṭṭhahati| lauṇasakkharikāya chinditunti khāraina chindituṃ| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, vaṇataila’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau yadi vaṇau na ruhati, vaṇaruhanatailaṃ pacitabbaṃ| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, vikāsikaṃ sabbaṃ vaṇapaṭikamma’’nti (mahāva॰ 267) vacanatau yadi tailaṃ gaḷati, vikāsikaṃ dātabbaṃ, sabbaṃ vaṇapaṭikammaṃ kātabbaṃ| tattha vikāsikanti tailarundhanapilautikaṃ| sabbaṃ vaṇapaṭikammanti yaṃ kiñ‍ci vaṇapaṭikammaṃ nāma atthi, sabbaṃ anujānāmīti atthau| mahāvikaṭakathā pubbai vuttāva|

sāmaṃ gahaitvāti idaṃ na kaivalaṃ sappadaṭṭhassaiva, añ‍ñasmimpi daṭṭhavisai sati sāmaṃ gahaitvā paribhuñ‍jitabbaṃ, añ‍ñaisu pana kāraṇaisu paṭiggahitamaiva vaṭṭati|

visapītakathā

visapītakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, gūthaṃ pāyaitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 268) vacanatau pītavisaṃ bhikkhuṃ gūthaṃ pāyaituṃ vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, yaṃ karauntau paṭiggaṇhāti, svaiva paṭiggahau katau, na puna paṭiggahaitabbau’’ti (mahāva॰ 268) vacanatau tadaiva vaṭṭati| aṭṭhakathāyaṃ (mahāva॰ aṭṭha॰ 268) pana na puna paṭiggahaitabbauti sacai bhūmippattau, paṭiggahāpaitabbau, appattaṃ pana gahaituṃ vaṭṭati|

gharadin‍nakābādhakathā

gharadin‍nakābādhakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, sītālauḷiṃ pāyaitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 269) vacanatau  gharadin‍nakābādhassa bhikkhunau sītālauḷiṃ pāyaituṃ vaṭṭati| tattha gharadin‍nakābādhauti vasīkaraṇapāṇakasamuṭṭhitaraugau| ṭīkāyaṃ (sārattha॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 3.269) pana  ‘‘gharadin‍nakābādhau nāma vasīkaraṇatthāya gharaṇiyā din‍nabhaisaj‍jasamuṭṭhitau ābādhau| taināha ‘vasīkaraṇapāṇakasamuṭṭhitaraugau’ti| ghara-saddau caittha abhaidaina gharaṇiyā vattamānau adhippaitau’’ti vuttaṃ| vimativinaudaniyampi (vi॰ vi॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 2.267-269) ‘‘gharadin‍nakābādhau nāma gharaṇiyā din‍navasīkaraṇabhaisaj‍jasamuṭṭhitau ābādhau’’ti vuttaṃ| sītālauḷinti naṅgalaina kasantassa phālai laggamattikaṃ udakaina ālauḷaitvā pāyaituṃ anujānāmīti atthau|

duṭṭhagahaṇikakathā

duṭṭhagahaṇikakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, āmisakhāraṃ pāyaitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 269) vacanatau duṭṭhagahaṇikassa bhikkhunau āmisakhāraṃ pāyaituṃ vaṭṭati| tattha duṭṭhagahaṇikauti vipan‍nagahaṇikau, kicchaina uc‍cārau nikkhamatīti atthau| āmisakhāranti sukkhaudanaṃ jhāpaitvā tāya chārikāya paggharitaṃ khāraudakaṃ| vimativinaudaniyaṃ (vi॰ vi॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 2.267-269) pana ‘‘tāya chārikāya paggharitaṃ khāraudakanti parissāvanai taṃ chārikaṃ pakkhipitvā udakai abhisiñ‍citai tatau chārikatau haiṭṭhā paggharitaṃ khāraudaka’’nti vuttaṃ|

paṇḍuraugābādhakathā

paṇḍuraugābādhakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, muttaharītakaṃ pāyaitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 269) vacanatau paṇḍuraugābādhassa bhikkhunau muttaharītakaṃ pāyaituṃ vaṭṭati| tattha muttaharītakanti gaumuttaparibhāvitaṃ harītakaṃ|

chavidausābādhakathā

chavidausābādhakathāyaṃ  ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, gandhālaipaṃ kātu’’nti (mahāva॰ 269) vacanatau chavidausābādhassa bhikkhunau gandhālaipaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati|

abhisan‍nakāyakathā

abhisan‍nakāyakathāyaṃ  ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, viraicanaṃ pātu’’nti (mahāva॰ 269) vacanatau abhisan‍nakāyassa bhikkhunau viraicanaṃ pātuṃ vaṭṭati| tattha abhisan‍nakāyauti ussan‍nadausakāyau| acchakañ‍jiyā atthau hauti, ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, acchakañ‍jiya’’nti (mahāva॰ 269) vacanatau acchakañ‍jiyaṃ pātuṃ vaṭṭati| tattha acchakañ‍jiyanti taṇḍulaudakamaṇḍau| akaṭayūsaina atthau hauti, ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, akaṭayūsa’’nti (mahāva॰ 269) vacanatau akaṭayūsaṃ pātuṃ vaṭṭati| tattha akaṭayūsanti asiniddhau muggapacitapānīyau| sāratthadīpaniyaṃ (sārattha॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 3.269) pana vimativinaudaniyañ‍ca (vi॰ vi॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 2.267-269) ‘‘akaṭayūsaināti anabhisaṅkhataina muggayūsainā’’ti vuttaṃ| kaṭākaṭaina atthau hauti, ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, kaṭākaṭa’’nti (mahāva॰ 269) vacanatau kaṭākaṭaṃ pāyaituṃ vaṭṭati| tattha kaṭākaṭanti sauva dhautasiniddhau| sāratthadīpaniyaṃ (sārattha॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 3.269) vimativinaudaniyañ‍ca (vi॰ vi॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 2.267-269) ‘‘kaṭākaṭaināti muggai pacitvā acālaitvāva parissāvitaina muggayūsainā’’ti vuttaṃ| paṭicchādanīyaina atthau hauti, ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, paṭicchādanīya’’nti (mahāva॰ 269) vacanatau paṭicchādanīyaṃ pātuṃ vaṭṭati| tattha paṭicchādanīyaināti maṃsarasaina|

lauṇasauvīrakakathā

lauṇasauvīrakakathāyaṃ  ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, gilānassa lauṇasauvīrakaṃ, agilānassa udakasambhin‍naṃ pānaparibhaugaina paribhuñ‍jitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 273) vacanatau gilānaina bhikkhunā lauṇasauvīrakaṃ pātabbaṃ, agilānaina udakasambhin‍naṃ katvā paribhuñ‍jitabbaṃ, tañ‍ca ‘‘pānaparibhaugainā’’ti vacanatau vikālaipi vaṭṭati|

tattha lauṇasauvīrakaṃ nāma sabbarasābhisaṅkhataṃ aikaṃ bhaisaj‍jaṃ, taṃ kira karauntau harītakāmalakavibhītakakasāvai sabbadhañ‍ñāni sabbaaparaṇṇāni sattan‍nampi dhañ‍ñānaṃ audanaṃ kadaliphalādīni sabbaphalāni vaittakaitakakhaj‍jūrikaḷīrādayau sabbakaḷīrai macchamaṃsakhaṇḍāni anaikāni  ca madhuphāṇitasindhavalauṇatikaṭukādīni bhaisaj‍jāni pakkhipitvā kumbhimukhaṃ limpitvā aikaṃ dvai tīṇi saṃvaccharāni ṭhapainti, taṃ paripac‍citvā jamburasavaṇṇaṃ hauti, vātakāsakuṭṭhapaṇḍubhagaṇḍalādīnaṃ siniddhabhaujanabhuttānañ‍ca uttarapānaṃ bhattajīraṇakabhaisaj‍jaṃ tādisaṃ natthi, taṃ panaitaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattampi vaṭṭati, gilānānaṃ pākatikamaiva| agilānānaṃ pana udakasambhin‍naṃ pānaparibhaugaināti|

sāratthadīpaniyaṃ (sārattha॰ ṭī॰ 2.191-192) pana ‘‘pānaparibhaugaināti vuttattā lauṇasauvīrakaṃ yāmakālika’’nti vuttaṃ| vimativinaudaniyaṃ (vi॰ vi॰ ṭī॰ 1.192) pana ‘‘pānaparibhaugaina vaṭṭatīti sambandhau| aivaṃ pana vuttattā lauṇasauvīrakaṃ yāmakālikanti kaici vadanti, kaici pana ‘gilānānaṃ pākatikamaiva, agilānānaṃ pana udakasambhin‍na’nti vuttattā guḷaṃ viya sattāhakālika’’nti vuttaṃ| vajirabuddhiṭīkāyaṃ (vajira॰ ṭī॰ mahāvagga 263) pana ‘‘avisaisaina satipac‍cayatā vuttā| imasmiṃ khandhakai ‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, gilānassa guḷaṃ, agilānassa guḷaudakaṃ, gilānassa lauṇasauvīrakaṃ, agilānassa udakasambhin‍na’nti (mahāva॰ 284) vuttaṃ, tasmā siddhaṃ ‘satipac‍cayatā gilānāgilānavasaina duvidhā’ti’’ vuttaṃ|

antauvutthādikathā

antauvutthādikathāyaṃ ‘‘taina khau pana samayaina bhagavatau udaravātābādhau hauti, atha khau āyasmā ānandau ‘pubbaipi bhagavatau udaravātābādhau taikaṭulayāguyā phāsu hautī’ti sāmaṃ tilampi taṇḍulampi muggampi viñ‍ñāpaitvā antau vāsaitvā antau sāmaṃ pacitvā bhagavatau upanāmaisi ‘pivatu bhagavā taikaṭulayāgu’nti| jānantāpi tathāgatā pucchanti, jānantāpi na pucchanti, kālaṃ viditvā pucchanti, kālaṃ viditvā na pucchanti, atthasañhitaṃ tathāgatā pucchanti, nau anatthasañhitaṃ, anatthasañhitai saitughātau tathāgatānaṃ| dvīhi ākāraihi buddhā bhagavantau bhikkhū paṭipucchanti ‘dhammaṃ vā daisaissāma, sāvakānaṃ vā sikkhāpadaṃ pañ‍ñapaissāmā’ti|

atha khau bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantaisi ‘kutāyaṃ, ānanda, yāgū’ti| atha khau  āyasmā ānandau bhagavatau aitamatthaṃ āraucaisi| vigarahi buddhau bhagavā ananucchavikaṃ, ānanda, ananulaumikaṃ appatirūpaṃ assamaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ, kathañhi nāma tvaṃ, ānanda, aivarūpāya bāhul‍lāya caitaissasi, yadapi, ānanda, antau vutthaṃ, tadapi akappiyaṃ| yadapi antau pak‍kaṃ, tadapi akappiyaṃ| yadapi sāmaṃ pak‍kaṃ, tadapi akappiyaṃ| naitaṃ, ānanda, appasan‍nānaṃ vā pasādāya…pai॰… vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantaisi – na, bhikkhavai, antau vutthaṃ antau  pak‍kaṃ sāmaṃ pak‍kaṃ paribhuñ‍jitabbaṃ, yau paribhuñ‍jaiyya, āpatti duk‍kaṭassa| antau cai, bhikkhavai, vutthaṃ antau pak‍kaṃ sāmaṃ pak‍kaṃ, tañ‍cai paribhuñ‍jaiyya, āpatti tiṇṇaṃ duk‍kaṭānaṃ| antau cai, bhikkhavai, vutthaṃ antau pak‍kaṃ añ‍ñaihi pak‍kaṃ, tañ‍cai paribhuñ‍jaiyya, āpatti dvin‍naṃ duk‍kaṭānaṃ| antau cai, bhikkhavai, vutthaṃ bahi pak‍kaṃ sāmaṃ pak‍kaṃ, tañ‍cai paribhuñ‍jaiyya, āpatti dvin‍naṃ duk‍kaṭānaṃ| bahi cai, bhikkhavai, vutthaṃ antau pak‍kaṃ sāmaṃ pak‍kaṃ, tañ‍cai paribhuñ‍jaiyya, āpatti dvin‍naṃ duk‍kaṭānaṃ| antau cai, bhikkhavai, vutthaṃ bahi pak‍kaṃ añ‍ñaihi pak‍kaṃ, tañ‍cai paribhuñ‍jaiyya, āpatti duk‍kaṭassa| bahi cai, bhikkhavai, vutthaṃ antau pak‍kaṃ añ‍ñaihi pak‍kaṃ, tañ‍cai paribhuñ‍jaiyya, āpatti duk‍kaṭassa| bahi cai, bhikkhavai, vutthaṃ bahi pak‍kaṃ sāmaṃ pak‍kaṃ, tañ‍cai paribhuñ‍jaiyya, āpatti duk‍kaṭassa| bahi cai, bhikkhavai, vutthaṃ bahi pak‍kaṃ añ‍ñaihi pak‍kaṃ, tañ‍cai paribhuñ‍jaiyya, anāpattī’’ti (mahāva॰ 274) vacanatau sahasaiyyappahaunakai ṭhānai vutthatā, tattha pak‍katā, upasampan‍naina sāmaṃ pak‍katāti imaisaṃ tiṇṇaṃ aṅgānaṃ sambhavai sati tissau āpattiyau, dvin‍naṃ sambhavai dvai āpattiyau, aikassa aṅgassa sambhavai aikā āpattīti vaiditabbaṃ|

antau vutthanti akappiyakuṭiyaṃ vutthaṃ| sāmaṃ pak‍kanti aittha yaṃ kiñ‍ci āmisaṃ bhikkhunau pacituṃ na vaṭṭati| sacaipissa uṇhayāguyā sulasipaṇṇāni vā siṅgivairaṃ vā lauṇaṃ vā pakkhipanti, tampi cālaituṃ na vaṭṭati| ‘‘yāguṃ nibbāpaimī’’ti pana cālaituṃ vaṭṭati| uttaṇḍubhattaṃ labhitvāpi pidahituṃ na vaṭṭati| sacai pana manussā pidahitvāva dainti, vaṭṭati| ‘‘bhattaṃ vā mā nibbāyatū’’ti pidahituṃ vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, puna pākaṃ pacitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 274) vacanatau pubbai anupasampan‍naihi pak‍kaṃ puna pacituṃ vaṭṭati| vuttañhi aṭṭhakathāyaṃ (mahāva॰ aṭṭha॰ 274) ‘‘khīratak‍kādīsu  pana sakiṃ kuthitaisu aggiṃ dātuṃ vaṭṭati punapākassa anuñ‍ñātattā’’ti| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, antau vāsaitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 274) vacanatau  dubbhikkhasamayai taṇḍulādīni antau vāsaituṃ vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, antau pacitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 274) vacanatau dubbhikkhasamayai antau pacituṃ vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, sāmaṃ pacitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 274) vacanatau dubbhikkhasamayai sāmampi pacituṃ vaṭṭati| ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, antau vutthaṃ antau pak‍kaṃ sāmaṃ pak‍ka’’nti (mahāva॰ 274) vacanatau dubbhikkhasamayai tīṇipi vaṭṭanti|

uggahitapaṭiggahitakathā

uggahitapaṭiggahitakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, yattha phalakhādanīyaṃ passati, kappiyakārakau ca na hauti, sāmaṃ gahaitvā haritvā kappiyakārakai passitvā bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipitvā paṭiggahāpaitvā paribhuñ‍jituṃ, anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, uggahitaṃ paṭiggahitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 275) vacanatau tathā katvā paribhuñ‍jituṃ vaṭṭati, āpatti na hautīti|

tataunīhaṭakathā

tatau nīhaṭakathāyaṃ ‘‘paṭiggaṇhatha, bhikkhavai, paribhuñ‍jatha| anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, tatau nīhaṭaṃ bhuttāvinā pavāritaina anatirittaṃ paribhuñ‍jitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 276) vacanatau yasmiṃ dānai nimantitā hutvā bhikkhū bhuñ‍janti, tatau dānatau nīhaṭaṃ bhaujanaṃ pavāritaina bhikkhunā bhuñ‍jitabbaṃ, na pavāritasikkhāpadaina āpatti hauti| vuttañhi aṭṭhakathāyaṃ (mahāva॰ aṭṭha॰ 276) ‘‘tatau nīhaṭanti yattha nimantitā bhuñ‍janti, tatau nīhaṭa’’nti|

puraibhattapaṭiggahitakathā

puraibhattapaṭiggahitakathāyaṃ  ‘‘paṭiggaṇhatha, bhikkhavai, paribhuñ‍jatha, anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, puraibhattaṃ paṭiggahitaṃ bhuttāvinā pavāritaina anatirittaṃ paribhuñ‍jitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 277) vacanatau puraibhattaṃ paṭiggahaitvā nikkhipitaṃ pavāritaina bhikkhunā atirittaṃ akatvā bhuñ‍jituṃ vaṭṭati, pavāritasikkhāpadaina āpatti na hauti|

vanaṭṭhapaukkharaṭṭhakathā

vanaṭṭhapaukkharaṭṭhakathāyaṃ  ‘‘taina khau pana samayaina āyasmatau sāriputtassa kāyaḍāhābādhau hauti| atha khau āyasmā mahāmauggal‍lānau yaināyasmā sāriputtau tainupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ aitadavauca ‘pubbai tai, āvusau sāriputta, kāyaḍāhābādhau kaina phāsu hautī’ti| bhisaihi ca mai, āvusau, muḷālikāhi cāti…pai॰… atha khau āyasmatau sāriputtassa bhisai ca muḷālikāyau ca paribhuttassa kāyaḍāhābādhau paṭippassambhi…pai॰… paṭiggaṇhatha, bhikkhavai, paribhuñ‍jatha| anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, vanaṭṭhaṃ paukkharaṭṭhaṃ bhuttāvinā pavāritaina anatirittaṃ paribhuñ‍jitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 278) vacanatau vanaṭṭhaṃ paukkharaṭṭhaṃ pavāritaina bhikkhunā paribhuñ‍jituṃ vaṭṭati, pavāritasikkhāpadaina āpatti na hauti| tattha vanaṭṭhaṃ paukkharaṭṭhanti vanai caiva paduminigacchai ca jātaṃ|

akatakappakathā

akatakappakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, abījaṃ nibbaṭṭabījaṃ akatakappaṃ phalaṃ paribhuñ‍jitu’’nti (mahāva॰ 278) vacanatau abījañ‍ca nibbaṭṭabījañ‍ca  phalaṃ aggisatthanakhaihi samaṇakappaṃ akatvāpi paribhuñ‍jituṃ vaṭṭati| tattha abījanti taruṇaphalaṃ, yassa bījaṃ aṅkuraṃ na janaiti| nibbaṭṭabījanti bījaṃ nibbaṭṭaitvā apanaitvā paribhuñ‍jitabbakaṃ ambapanasādi, tāni phalāni kappiyakārakai asati kappaṃ akatvāpi paribhuñ‍jituṃ vaṭṭati|

yāgukathā

yāgukathāyaṃ ‘‘dasayimai, brāhmaṇa, ānisaṃsā yāguyā| katamai dasa, yāguṃ daintau āyuṃ daiti, vaṇṇaṃ daiti, sukhaṃ daiti, balaṃ daiti, paṭibhānaṃ daiti, yāgupītā khudaṃ paṭihanati, pipāsaṃ vinaiti, vātaṃ anulaumaiti, vatthiṃ saudhaiti, āmāvasaisaṃ pācaiti| imai khau, brāhmaṇa, dasānisaṃsā yāguyāti|

‘yau  sañ‍ñatānaṃ paradattabhaujinaṃ|

kālaina sak‍kac‍ca dadāti yāguṃ|

dasassa ṭhānāni anuppavaicchati|

āyuñ‍ca vaṇṇañ‍ca sukhaṃ balañ‍ca||

‘paṭibhānamassa upajāyatai tatau|

khuddaṃ pipāsañ‍ca byapanaiti vātaṃ|

saudhaiti vatthiṃ pariṇāmaiti bhattaṃ|

bhaisaj‍jamaitaṃ sugataina vaṇṇitaṃ||

‘tasmā hi yāguṃ alamaiva dātuṃ|

nic‍caṃ manussaina sukhatthikaina|

dibbāni vā patthayatā sukhāni|

mānussasaubhagyatamicchatā vā’ti||

atha khau bhagavā taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumauditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pak‍kāmi| atha khau bhagavā aitasmiṃ nidānai aitasmiṃ pakaraṇai dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantaisi – anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, yāguñ‍ca madhugauḷakañ‍cā’’ti  (mahāva॰ 282) vacanatau yāguñ‍ca madhugauḷakañ‍ca sampaṭicchituṃ vaṭṭati| anumaudanāgāthāya ‘‘patthayataṃ icchata’’nti padānaṃ ‘‘alamaiva dātu’’nti iminā sambandhau| sacai pana ‘‘patthayatā icchatā’’ti pāṭhau atthi, sauyaiva gahaitabbau| ‘‘na, bhikkhavai, añ‍ñatra nimantitaina añ‍ñassa bhauj‍jayāgu paribhuñ‍jitabbā, yau paribhuñ‍jaiyya, yathādhammau kāraitabbau’’ti (mahāva॰ 283) vacanatau tathā bhuñ‍jantassa paramparabhaujanasikkhāpadaina āpatti hauti| bhauj‍jayāgūti yā pavāraṇaṃ janaiti| yathādhammau kāraitabbauti paramparabhaujanaina kāraitabbau|

guḷakathā

guḷakathāyaṃ ‘‘anujānāmi, bhikkhavai, gilānassa guḷaṃ, agilānassa guḷaudaka’’nti (mahāva॰ 284) vacanatau  gilānau bhikkhu guḷapiṇḍaṃ vikālaipi khādituṃ vaṭṭati| agilānau pana udakasambhin‍naṃ katvā guḷaudakaparibhaugaina paribhuñ‍jituṃ vaṭṭati| ‘‘gilānassa guḷanti tathārūpaina byādhinā gilānassa pacchābhattaṃ guḷaṃ anujānāmīti atthau’’ti aṭṭhakathāyaṃ (mahāva॰ aṭṭha॰ 284) vuttaṃ| ‘‘tathārūpaina byādhinā’’ti vuttattā yathārūpaina byādhinā gilānassa guḷau paribhuñ‍jitabbau hauti, tathārūpaina aiva byādhinā gilānassāti vuttaṃ viya dissati, vīmaṃsitvā gahaitabbaṃ|

aittakāsu kathāsu yā yā saṃvaṇṇaitabbappakaraṇai na dissati, sā sā amhaihi paisalānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kausal‍latthaṃ pāḷitau ca aṭṭhakathātau ca gahaitvā ṭīkācariyānaṃ vacanaihi alaṅkaritvā ṭhapitā, tasmā nik‍kaṅkhā hutvā paṇḍitā upadhāraintu|

catumahāpadaisakathā

67. yaṃ  bhikkhavaitiādi mahāpadaisakathā nāma| tattha mahantai atthai upadissati aitaihīti mahāpadaisā, mahantā vā atthā padissanti pañ‍ñāyanti aitthāti mahāpadaisā, mahantānaṃ vā atthānaṃ padaisau pavattidaisauti mahāpadaisā| kai tai? imaiyaiva cattārau pāṭhā, atthā vā| taina vuttaṃ ‘‘imai cattārau mahāpadaisai’’tiādi| tattha dhammasaṅgāhakatthairāti mahākassapādayau| suttaṃ gahaitvāti ‘‘ṭhapaitvā dhañ‍ñaphalarasa’’ntiādikaṃ suttaṃ gahaitvā upadhāraintau| satta dhañ‍ñānīti –

‘‘sāli vīhi ca kudrūsau, gaudhumau varakau yavau|

kaṅgūti satta dhañ‍ñāni, nīvārādī tu tabbhidā’’ti –||

vuttāni satta dhañ‍ñāni| sabbaṃ aparaṇṇanti muggamāsādayau| aṭṭha pānānīti ambapānaṃ jambupānaṃ caucapānaṃ maucapānaṃ sālukapānaṃ muddikapānaṃ madhukapānaṃ phārusakapānañ‍ca|

iminā nayaināti suttānulaumanayaina| vuttañhaitaṃ aṭṭhakathāyaṃ ‘‘suttānulaumaṃ nāma cattārau mahāpadaisā’’ti| pāḷiñ‍ca aṭṭhakathañ‍ca anapaikkhitvāti pāḷiyaṃ nītatthatau āgatamaiva aggahaitvā| añ‍ñānipīti tatau añ‍ñānipi| aitaina mahāpadaisā nāma na kaivalaṃ yathāvuttā aiva, atha khau anaikāni nānappakārāni vinayadharassa ñāṇānubhāvappakāsitānīti dassaiti|

ānisaṃsakathā

68. ānisaṃsakathāyaṃ vinayaṃ dhāraitīti vinayadharau, sikkhanavācanamanasikāravinicchayanatadanulaumakaraṇādinā vinayapariyattikusalau  bhikkhu| vinayapariyattimūlaṃ aitaisanti vinayapariyattimūlakā| kai tai? pañ‍cānisaṃsā| vinayapariyattiyaiva mūlaṃ kāraṇaṃ katvā labhitabbaānisaṃsā, na añ‍ñapariyattiṃ vā paṭipattiādayau vā mūlaṃ katvāti atthau| atha vā pariyāpuṇanaṃ pariyatti, vinayassa pariyatti vinayapariyatti, sā mūlaṃ aitaisanti vinayapariyattimūlakā, vinayapariyāpuṇanahaitubhavā ānisaṃsāti atthau| ‘‘katamai’’tiādinā taisaṃ pañ‍cānisaṃsādīnaṃ sarūpaṃ pucchitvā ‘‘attanau’’tiādinā vissaj‍jaitvā taṃ vacanaṃ pāḷiyā samatthaituṃ ‘‘vuttañhaita’’ntiādimāha|

aivaṃ pañ‍cānisaṃsānaṃ sarūpaṃ dassaitvā idāni taiyaiva vitthāratau dassaituṃ ‘‘kathamassā’’tiādinā pucchitvā ‘‘idhaikac‍cau’’tiādinā vissaj‍jaiti| tattha attanau sīlakkhandhasuguttabhāvau nāma āpattianāpaj‍janabhāvainaiva hauti, nau añ‍ñathāti āpattiāpaj‍janakāraṇaṃ dassaitvā tadabhāvaina anāpaj‍janaṃ dassaituṃ ‘‘āpattiṃ āpaj‍jantau chahākāraihi āpaj‍jatī’’tiādimāha| tattha –

‘‘sañ‍cic‍ca āpattiṃ āpaj‍jati|

āpattiṃ parigūhati|

agatigamanañ‍ca gacchati|

aidisau vuc‍cati alaj‍jipuggalau’’ti|| (pari॰ 359) –

vuttaina alaj‍jīlakkhaṇaina na laj‍jati na hirīyatīti alaj‍jī, tassa bhāvau alaj‍jitā| natthi ñāṇaṃ aitassāti añ‍ñāṇaṃ, tassa bhāvau añ‍ñāṇatā| kukatassa bhāvau kuk‍kuc‍caṃ, taina pakatau kuk‍kuc‍capakatau, tassa bhāvau kuk‍kuc‍capakatatā| kappatīti kappiyaṃ, na kappiyaṃ akappiyaṃ, tasmiṃ akappiyai, kappiyaṃ iti sañ‍ñā yassa sau kappiyasañ‍ñī, tassa bhāvau kappiyasañ‍ñitā| itaraṃ tappaṭipakkhatau kātabbaṃ, imaisu pañ‍casu padaisu yakāralaupau, tasmā ‘‘alaj‍jitāya āpattiṃ āpaj‍jatī’’tiādinā yaujaitabbāni| haitvatthai caitaṃ nissak‍kavacanaṃ| saratīti sati, samussanaṃ sammausau| satiyā sammausau satisammausau, tasmā satisammausā| haitvatthai caitaṃ karaṇavacanaṃ| idāni tāni kāraṇāni vitthāratau dassaituṃ ‘‘katha’’ntyādimāha| taṃ nayānuyaugaina viñ‍ñaiyyamaiva|

ariṭṭhau iti bhikkhu ariṭṭhabhikkhu, kaṇṭakau iti sāmaṇairau kaṇṭakasāmaṇairau, vaisāliyā jātā vaisālikā, vaj‍jīnaṃ puttā vaj‍jiputtā, vaisālikā ca tai vaj‍jiputtā cāti vaisālikavaj‍jiputtā, ariṭṭhabhikkhu ca kaṇṭakasāmaṇairau ca vaisālikavaj‍jiputtā ca ariṭṭhabhikkhukaṇṭakasāmaṇairavaisālikavaj‍jiputtakā| parūpahārau ca añ‍ñāṇañ‍ca kaṅkhāvitaraṇañ‍ca parūpahāraañ‍ñāṇakaṅkhāvitaraṇā| kai tai? vādā| tai ādi yaisaṃ taiti parūpahāraañ‍ñāṇakaṅkhāvitaraṇādayau| vadanti aitaihīti vādā, parūpahāraañ‍ñāṇakaṅkhāvitaraṇādayau vādā aitaisanti parū…pai॰… vādā| kai tai? micchāvādinau| ariṭṭha…pai॰… puttā ca parūpahāra…pai॰… vādā ca mahāsaṅghikādayau ca sāsanapac‍catthikā nāmāti samuc‍cayadvandavasaina yaujanā kātabbā| saisaṃ suviñ‍ñaiyyamaiva|

ānisaṃsakathā niṭṭhitā|

iti vinayasaṅgahasaṃvaṇṇanābhūtai vinayālaṅkārai

pakiṇṇakavinicchayakathālaṅkārau nāma

catuttiṃsatimau paricchaidau|

nigamanakathāvaṇṇanā

nigamagāthāsu  paṭhamagāthāyaṃ saddhammaṭṭhitikāmaina sāsanuj‍jautakārinā parak‍kamabāhunā narindaina ajjhaisitau sau ahaṃ vinayasaṅgahaṃ akāsinti yaujanā|

dutiyatatiyagāthāyaṃ  tainaiva parak‍kamabāhunarindainaiva kāritai rammai ramaṇīyai pāsādasatamaṇḍitai pāsādānaṃ sataina paṭimaṇḍitai nānādumagaṇākiṇṇai bhāvanābhiratālayai bhāvanāya abhiratānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ālayabhūtai sītalūdakasampan‍nai jaitavanai jaitavananāmakai vihārai vasaṃ vasantau hutvā, atha vā vasaṃ vasantau sauhaṃ sau ahaṃ yaugīnaṃ hitaṃ hitabhūtaṃ sāraṃ sāravantaṃ imaṃ īdisaṃ vinayasaṅgahaṃ akāsinti yaujanā|

saisagāthāsu iminā ganthakaraṇaina yaṃ puñ‍ñaṃ mayhaṃ siddhaṃ, añ‍ñaṃ itau ganthakaraṇatau añ‍ñabhūtaṃ yaṃ puñ‍ñaṃ mayā pasutaṃ hauti, aitaina puñ‍ñakammaina dutiyai attasambhavai tāvatiṃsai pamaudaintau sīlācāraguṇai ratau pañ‍cakāmaisu alaggau daivaputtau hutvā paṭhamaṃ paṭhamabhūtaṃ phalaṃ sautāpattiphalaṃ patvāna antimai attabhāvamhi laukaggapuggalaṃ nāthaṃ nāthabhūtaṃ sabbasattahitai rataṃ maittaiyyaṃ maittaiyyanāmakaṃ munipuṅgavaṃ munisaiṭṭhaṃ disvāna tassa dhīrassa saddhammadaisanaṃ sutvā aggaṃ phalaṃ arahattaphalaṃ adhigantvā labhitvā jinasāsanaṃ saubhaiyyaṃ saubhāpaiyyanti ayaṃ pākaṭayaujanā|

aitissāya pana yaujanāya sati ācariyavarassa vacanaṃ na sampaṭicchanti paṇḍitā| kathaṃ? aittha hi itau dutiyabhavai tāvatiṃsabhavanai daivaputtau hutvā sautāpattiphalaṃ patvā antimabhavai maittaiyyassa bhagavatau dhammadaisanaṃ sutvā arahattaphalaṃ labhaiyyanti ācariyassa patthanā, sā ayuttarūpā  hauti| sautāpan‍nassa hi sattabhavatau uddhaṃ paṭisandhi natthi, tāvatiṃsānañ‍ca daivānaṃ bhavasatainapi bhavasahassainapi bhavasatasahassainapi maittaiyyassa bhagavatau uppaj‍janakālau appattabbau hauti| athāpi vadaiyya ‘‘antarā brahmalaukai nibbattitvā maittaiyyassa bhagavatau kālai manussau bhavaiyyā’’ti, aivampi na yuj‍jati| na hi brahmalaukagatānaṃ ariyānaṃ puna kāmabhavūpapatti atthi| vuttañhi abhidhammai yamakappakaraṇai (yama॰ 2.anusayayamaka. 312) ‘‘rūpadhātuyā cutassa kāmadhātuṃ upapaj‍jantassa sattaiva anusayā anusaintī’’ti| athāpi vadaiyya ‘‘brahmalaukaiyaiva ṭhatvā aggaphalaṃ labhaiyyā’’ti, tathā ca ācariyassa vacanai na dissati, ‘‘saubhaiyyaṃ jinasāsana’’nti vuttattā bhikkhubhūtattamaiva dissati| na hi bhikkhubhūtau sāsanaṃ saubhāpaituṃ sak‍kauti| abhidhammatthavibhāvaniyañ‍ca –

‘‘jautayantaṃ  tadā tassa, sāsanaṃ suddhamānasaṃ|

passaiyyaṃ sak‍karaiyyañ‍ca, garuṃ mai sārisambhava’’nti|| –

bhikkhubhūtamaiva vuttaṃ| athāpi vadaiyya ‘‘antarā dīghāyukau bhummadaivau hutvā tadā manussau bhavaiyyā’’ti, aivampi aikassa buddhassa sāvakabhūtau ariyapuggalau puna añ‍ñassa buddhassa sāvakau na bhavaiyyāti, ācariyau pana sabbapariyattidharau anaikaganthakārakau anaikaisaṃ ganthakārakānaṃ thairānaṃ ācariyapācariyabhūtau, taina na kaivalaṃ idhaiva imā gāthāyau ṭhapitā, atha khau sāratthadīpanīnāmikāya vinayaṭīkāya avasānai ca ṭhapitā, tasmā bhavitabbamaittha kāraṇaināti vīmaṃsitabbamaitaṃ|

atha vā iminā…pai॰… daivaputtau hutvā paṭhamaṃ tāva phalaṃ yathāvuttaṃ tāvatiṃsai pamaudanasīlācāraguṇai rataṃ  pañ‍cakāmaisu alaggabhāvasaṅkhātaṃ ānisaṃsaṃ patvāna antimai attabhāvamhi…pai॰… saubhaiyyanti yaujanā| atha vā iminā…pai॰… pañ‍cakāmaisu alaggau hutvā antimai attabhāvamhi…pai॰… saddhammadaisanaṃ sutvā paṭhamaṃ phalaṃ sautāpattiphalaṃ patvā tatau paraṃ aggaphalaṃ arahattaphalaṃ adhigantvā jinasāsanaṃ saubhaiyyanti yaujanā| yathā amhākaṃ bhagavatau dhammacak‍kappavattanasuttantadhammadaisanaṃ sutvā añ‍ñātakauṇḍañ‍ñatthairau sautāpattiphalaṃ patvā pacchā arahattaphalaṃ adhigantvā jinasāsanaṃ saubhaisi, aivanti atthau| itau añ‍ñānipi nayāni yathā thairassa vacanānukūlāni, tāni paṇḍitaihi cintaitabbāni|

nigamanakathāvaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā|

nigamanakathā

1.

 jambudīpatalai  rammai, marammavisayai sutai|

tambadīparaṭṭhai ṭhitaṃ, puraṃ ratananāmakaṃ||

2.

 jinasāsanapaj‍jautaṃ, anaikaratanākaraṃ|

sādhuj‍janānamāvāsaṃ, sauṇṇapāsādalaṅkataṃ||

3.

 tasmiṃ ratanapuramhi, rājānaikaraṭṭhissarau|

sirīsudhammarājāti, mahāadhipatīti ca||

4.

 aivaṃnāmau mahātaijau, raj‍jaṃ kāraisi dhammatau|

kārāpaisi rājā maṇi-cūḷaṃ mahantacaitiyaṃ||

5.

 tassa kālai brahārañ‍ñai, tiriyau nāma pabbatau|

pubbakārañ‍ñavāsīnaṃ, nivāsau bhāvanārahau||

6.

 aṭṭhārasahi dausaihi, muttau pañ‍caṅgupāgatau|

arañ‍ñalakkhaṇaṃ pattau, baddhasīmāyalaṅkatau||

7.

 tasmiṃ pabbatai vasantau, mahāthairau supākaṭau|

tipaiṭakālaṅkārauti, dvikkhattuṃ laddhalañchanau||

8.

 taibhātukanarindānaṃ, garubhūtau supaisalau|

kusalau pariyattimhi, paṭipattimhi kārakau||

9.

 sauhaṃ laj‍jīpaisalaihi, bhikkhūhi abhiyācitau|

sāsanassaupakārāya, akāsiṃ sīlavaḍḍhanaṃ||

10.

 vinayālaṅkāraṃ nāma, laj‍jīnaṃ upakārakaṃ|

suṭṭhu vinayasaṅgaha-vaṇṇanaṃ sādhusaivitaṃ||

11.

 rūpachiddanāsakaṇṇai, sampattai jinasāsanai|

chiddasuñ‍ñasuñ‍ñarūpai, kaliyugamhi āgatai||

12.

 niṭṭhāpitā ayaṃ ṭīkā, mayā sāsanakāraṇā|

dvīsu sauṇṇavihāraisu, dvikkhattuṃ laddhakaitunā||

13.

 iminā puñ‍ñakammaina, añ‍ñaina kusalaina ca|

itau cutāhaṃ dutiyai, attabhāvamhi āgatai||

14.

 himavantapadaisamhi, pabbatai gandhamādanai|

āsan‍nai maṇiguhāya, mañ‍jūsakadumassa ca||

15.

 tasmiṃ haissaṃ bhummadaivau, atidīghāyukau varau|

pañ‍ñāvīriyasampan‍nau, buddhasāsanamāmakau||

16.

 yāva tiṭṭhati sāsanaṃ, tāva caitiyavandanaṃ|

baudhipūjaṃ saṅghapūjaṃ, karaiyyaṃ tuṭṭhamānasau||

17.

 bhikkhūnaṃ paṭipan‍nānaṃ, vaiyyāvac‍caṃ karaiyyahaṃ|

pariyattābhiyuttānaṃ, kaṅkhāvinaudayaiyyahaṃ||

18.

 sāsanaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ, rājūnaṃ sahāyau assaṃ|

sāsanaṃ niggaṇhantānaṃ, vāraituṃ samatthau assaṃ||

19.

 sāsanantaradhānai tu, mañ‍jūsaṃ rukkhamuttamaṃ|

nandamūlañ‍ca pabbhāraṃ, nic‍caṃ pūjaṃ karaiyyahaṃ||

20.

 yadā  tu pac‍caikabuddhā, uppaj‍janti mahāyasā|

tadā taisaṃ nic‍cakappaṃ, upaṭṭhānaṃ karaiyyahaṃ||

21.

 tainaiva attabhāvaina, yāva buddhuppādā ahaṃ|

tiṭṭhantau buddhuppādamhi, manussaisu bhavāmahaṃ||

22.

 maittaiyyassa  bhagavatau, pabbajitvāna sāsanai|

tausayitvāna jinaṃ taṃ, labhai byākaraṇuttamaṃ||

23.

 byākaraṇaṃ labhitvāna, pūraitvā sabbapāramī|

anāgatamhi addhānai, buddhau haissaṃ sadaivakaiti||

vinayālaṅkāraṭīkā samattā|
